# dsh-book
English · 简体中文
> A writing workspace for DeepSeek Harness: a Markdown draft library, platform-aware editors for Xia
ohongshu / WeChat official accounts / generic posts, and an AI copywriting assistant that streams fr
om your profile's default model.
## Features
- **Draft library** — one Markdown file per draft, in a folder you choose (default `~/Documents/DSH写

作`,
created on first save); browse, search (title + body excerpt), create, refresh and delete; draft

s are
ordinary files, so Obsidian, Git and `vim` can share the same folder.
- **Editor** — Xiaohongs

hu / WeChat / generic platform profiles with live title and body counters
(soft limits: amber warnin

gs, saving is never blocked); tag chips (`Enter` or `,` adds, `Backspace`
in an empty field removes

the last one); ~0.9 s autosave with a live status; copy the whole post
(title + body + `#hashtags`)

or just the body; renaming the title renames the file (a collision gets
a ` (2)` suffix); delete tak

es two clicks.
- **AI copywriting assistant** — six modes (Draft, Polish, Expand, Tighten, Titles, T

ags) streaming
token by token with a Stop button, platform-aware prompts (Xiaohongshu hooks and hash

tags, WeChat
subheads, neutral generic tone) and one-click apply back into the editor; runs on the c

urrent DSH
profile's default model through the host `llm` service, with no API key setup inside the

panel.
- **Fit and finish** — bilingual UI (Chinese / English) that follows the DSH locale, theme-aw

are
styling on DSH design tokens so light and dark mode follow the app, no build step, no runtime
de
pendencies and no background processes.
## Install
Prerequisite: a working DeepSeek Harness install (`dsh`). The default profile is usually `web`.
### From GitHub (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local clone
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### DSH desktop app

Open the **Plugins** page, install from a local directory, and point it at the cloned `dsh-book`
fol

der (or paste the GitHub repo path). After installing, restart `dsh web` or refresh the page: a
pen-

icon **Writing** (写作) entry shows up in the sidebar panel list. To update, run the same `add`
comman
d again; to remove the plugin, run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-book`.
### Requirements
| Requirement | Notes |
| DSH | plugin-bundle support with the `sidebar.panellist` / `main` slots; tested on `0.2.2-rc.1` |

| Node.js | >= 20 |
| Default model | optional; required for the AI panel (uses the profile's defaul

t provider + model) |
| Runtime dependencies | none — plain ESM on the host, plain browser JS on the

r + model) |
| Runtime dependencies | none — plain ESM on the host, plain browser JS on the client |
## Usage

Click the pen icon labeled **Writing** in the sidebar. The workspace has three columns: library,
edi
tor and AI assistant; the newest draft opens automatically once the library loads, and **New work**
starts an empty one.
### Edit a draft
1. Pick a platform next to the title counter, then type the title and body (counters turn amber past

the platform limit, but nothing is blocked).
2. Add tags; they are stored in `frontmatter` and copi

ed by **Copy all**. Everything autosaves.
[该节后续省略]
## How it works

- **Host half** (`index.js`): exports `inject: ['webServer']` and mounts one prefix route,
`/dsh-boo

k/api`, on the DSH host web server through `ctx.effect` + `ctx.webServer.register`.
- **Draft storag

e**: plain `node:fs`; saves are atomic (temp file + rename), file names are derived
from the title a

nd validated against path traversal, and every operation is bounded (1 MiB request
body, 2 MiB draft

file, 500 listed drafts).
- **Generation**: reads `ctx.get('agentDefaultModel').currentSelection()`

for provider/model and
streams through `ctx.llm.stream(...)`, emitting Server-Sent Events (`start`

→ `delta` → `done` /
`error`); closing the browser stream aborts the upstream request.
- **Prompts**

: a shared Chinese copywriting baseline (no fabricated facts or numbers, no medical or
absolute clai

ms, no ad tone) plus a per-platform style block; each author field is trimmed to
12,000 characters.

- **Client half** (`client.js`): loaded by DSH's module loader, registers the `sidebar.panellist`
en

try (order 20, pen icon, localized label) and the `main` panel keyed `writing`; React comes from
the

shell module table. Draft CRUD goes through `fetch`; the folder override lives in
`localStorage` un

der `dsh-book.directory`; styles are one `<style data-plugin>` element using DSW
theme variables.
## Data & privacy
- **Your drafts stay local.** Every draft is one `.md` file in the folder shown at the bottom-left o

f
the panel (default `~/Documents/DSH写作`; any absolute path, `~` accepted). No database, no sync.
-
**The folder preference is browser-local** (`localStorage` key `dsh-book.directory`), never written

to disk by the plugin.
- **Only the AI call leaves the machine.** A generation request sends the mod

e, platform, your brief /
extra requirements and the current title, body and tags to your configured

model provider through
DSH's `llm` service; each text field is trimmed to 12,000 characters. Other

drafts, file names,
folder paths and any other local data are never sent.
- **No telemetry.** The pl

ugin makes no network calls of its own — no analytics, crash reporting or
remote config. The route r

ejects non-loopback hosts and cross-site requests, so another site cannot
read your drafts through t

k hosts and cross-site requests, so another site cannot
read your drafts through the DSH web server.
## Compatibility

- **DSH / OS**: the Web UI served by `dsh web` and the DSH desktop app (tested on `0.2.2-rc.1`) on
m

acOS, Windows or Linux — the host half only uses Node core modules, the client half browser APIs.
-

**Plugin API caveat**: this is an external plugin bundle (`cordis.patch.yml` + `dsh.bundle` /
`dsh.c

lient` manifests) that depends on the `webServer`, `slots` and `locale` services, the `main`
and `si

debar.panellist` slots, and — for AI — the `llm` and `agentDefaultModel` services. If DSH
renames th

ose, the panel needs a matching update. Model providers work as long as they can be set
as the profi
le's default model; the panel never talks to a provider directly.
